# Paper A: Test Fixture

## Introduction

This paper introduces a simple model for testing the comparison pipeline.
We ask whether a linear model is sufficient for this task.

## Method

We use ordinary least squares regression to estimate the coefficients.
The training sample covers 2015 through 2022.

## Results

The model achieves an R-squared of 0.85 on the holdout set.
We conclude that the linear specification is adequate for this fixture.
